esther.docs: Heads up — doing a refresh pass on the Quickstart 'hello-boot' tutorial before next week's onboarding cohort. Found a couple of small but high-friction issues: the fetch example sets a Basic header, copy-paste leftover; the Dockerfile uses the legacy import path; and the playground "Copy" button breaks after the inline code change.
kai.eng: Paste the buggy fetch snippet?
esther.docs: Current snippet (in step 3):
```js
fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  headers: { Authorization: `Basic ${process.env.REDWOOD_API_TOKEN}` },
  method: 'POST'
})
```
Should be Bearer and use the SDK example instead for first-timers.
mohit.devex: We should keep the snippet minimal: use the SDK one-liner and a tiny raw-fetch example for advanced users. Also add a PowerShell example for setting env var — some Windows users hit this during the last cohort.
jen.qa: I saw the playground regression locally: after the snippet swap the copy button JS tries to read data-playground-id which our snippet generator no longer emits. Might need a small patch to the docs script.
kai.eng: OK I'll: 1) change fetch header to Bearer, 2) replace raw snippet with SDK one-liner in the primary quickstart, 3) fix Dockerfile import to `import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference'`, and 4) open a follow-up PR to restore data-playground-id in the generator.
mohit.devex: For PowerShell let's add a tiny block: `$env:REDWOOD_API_TOKEN = 'your_token_here'` and a note that this sets it only for the current session.
doc-lint-bot: Reminder: run docs-lint after changes to catch broken anchors.
kai.eng: Opening PR now. Will include: changelog line, migration note for header (Basic -> Bearer), and an integration smoke test that ensures the playground copy works.
jen.qa: I'll queue a quick cross-platform smoke run and verify Node 18/20, Windows runners as well. Report back with any flakiness.
kai.eng: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1337 "fix(quickstart): auth header, docker import, playground id, powershell note"
mohit.devex: Thanks — once merged can we push a short onboarding patch note so instructors pull latest before the cohort?
esther.docs: Yep, I'll add a one-line update to the Instructor Checklist and drop a note in #help and the instructors mailing list. :thumbsup:
jen.qa: CI green so far, running Windows runner now. Will update thread with results.
doc-lint-bot: Link check passed.
jen.qa: Windows run passed, no flakes. Good to merge.
kai.eng: Merged. Closing follow-up issue for playground generator.
mohit.devex: Great work team — this should reduce first-day confusion.
esther.docs: Thanks all! I'll mark the quickstart as reviewed in our docs backlog and move the task to "Done."
